title: Moments of a two-coordinate Rademacher norm
statement: For a uniformly random sign vector $x=(x_1,x_2)\in\{-1,1\}^2$, the norm of the sum of its coordinates has first moment $1$ and second moment $2$: $\mathbb{E}|x_1+x_2|=1$ and $\mathbb{E}|x_1+x_2|^2=2$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is uniformly distributed on the two-dimensional sign cube
